searchText: Noob question. Is there a hard guarantee that for every ECDSA public key there is exactly one private key? Or perhaps more generally (I think, please correct me if this question doesn't make sense), is it guaranteed that for a given elliptic curve, for each point Q, there exists only one point P that can be multiplied by the field size to reach that Q? Does anyone know what other blockchains exist out there that support contracts, but not from some version of the EVM?
